== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウォーカーの猛攻</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か屋外の隣接位置にある固定兵器を目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＋1＞没収値なら目標はロストする。さらに運命数＋1＞6なら目標と同じ位置にいる相手のキャラクターも1名ロストする（複数いるなら無作為に選ぶ）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴに満載された兵員が実際に外に出て敵と交戦する前に、ウォーカーは反乱分子の防御装置を破壊しておかなければならない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Walker Barrage.

'''Lore''' — Before the troops packed into an AT-AT actually go outside and fight the enemy, the walker must destroy the Rebel elements' defenses.

'''Game text''' — If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target an artillery weapon at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. The target is lost if destiny +1 exceeds forfeit. One opponent's character at the target's location is also lost if destiny +1 exceeds 6, chosen at random if more than one is there.

Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. Lore says 反乱分子 rather than Rebel traitors. Destiny +1 thresholds match the English face.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-walkerbarrage-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Walker Barrage]].</ref>
